coding_conventions.package_structure: Feature packages under kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.<feature>; each complete backend feature commonly has Controller, Service, Mapper, records, and a mapper XML resource (for example permissions).
coding_conventions.dto_style: Java records are dominant: 393 of 707 production Java files declare public record; request, row, criteria, and response types are feature-local records.
coding_conventions.service_style: Spring @Service classes with constructor injection and @Transactional boundaries are dominant: 82 production Java files contain @Transactional; MenuPermissionManagementService is a representative implementation.
coding_conventions.persistence_style: MyBatis XML mapper is dominant: 76 mapper XML files under backend/src/main/resources/mapper, while annotation SQL appears in 8 production Java files. Mapper interfaces use @Mapper and @Param; follow XML mapping unless a staged specification explicitly requires otherwise.
coding_conventions.controller_response_style: Spring @RestController methods return ApiResponse<T>; 85 production Java files use ApiResponse<. ApiResponse is defined in backend/src/main/java/kr/ac/knue/commonfoundation/common/api/ApiResponse.java.

conventions.primary_key: Existing schema uses bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY for surrogate keys and natural varchar primary keys where applicable (backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__common_foundation_schema.sql).
conventions.fk_column_pattern: Referenced keys use singular entity names with _id where surrogate keys are used (for example user_id, menu_id); organization_code and role_code are used for natural-key references.
conventions.index_name_pattern: idx_{table or abbreviated subject}_{column or purpose}, for example idx_menu_permissions_lookup and idx_users_employee_no.
conventions.soft_delete_pattern: status varchar(20) with ACTIVE, INACTIVE, and often DELETED check values; no deleted_at convention is evidenced in V1.
evidence: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__common_foundation_schema.sql:1-299 defines identity/natural keys, audit timestamps, foreign-key naming, status checks, and idx_ indexes.
